create_MetricStats: create a MetricStats object to track total, mean, min, max, and standard deviation of a metric
build_MetricStatsDict: build a MetricStatsDict to store and combine multiple MetricStats instances by key
test_Stats: test the Stats class that aggregates timing and metric stats for a pipeline block
summarize_PipelineStats: summarize a PipelineStats object that combines per-block stats across an entire pipeline
run_TimingStats: run TimingStats as a context manager to measure elapsed time and track global timing statistics
